dict.title: Ajan ön ayarı
dict.description: Applies to oturums you start from now on. Çalışıyor oturums keep the preset they began with.
dict.seatHint: Agent preset for the oturum you are about to start
dict.headerHint: The agent preset this oturum runs, fixed when it started
dict.sectionIntro: A preset is the eklenti composition one oturum's agent runs — its araçs, prompt, and capabilities. Duplicate an existing one and make it yours, or let the agent draft one for you in Creator mode.
dict.presetStandardDescription: Full coding agent with dosya editing, shell, dosya and web search, skills, planning, hedefs, subagents, and workflows.
dict.presetCodeDescription: All Standard mode capabilities, with araçs exposed through the Code Mode SDK so the model can combine multi-step operations in one TypeScript program.
dict.presetMinimalDescription: Two-araç coding agent with persistent bash and str_replace_editor.
dict.presetCordisDescription: Built for creating özel agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, eklenti experiments, and preset-authoring guidance.
dict.duplicateUnavailable: Bu dağıtımda yazılabilir bir ön ayar dizini yok
dict.displayNamePlaceholder: Göstern in the picker; varsayılans to the identifier
dict.brokenNoCopy: A preset that başarısız to yükle cannot be duplicated
dict.copyIntro: The whole preset is copied on this machine. The identifier becomes its directory ad and cannot be changed later; everything else is edited in the preset's own dosyas.
dict.creatorDraft: Draft a özel preset with Creator mode
dict.idInvalid: Küçük harfler, rakamlar ve tireler kullanın; bir harf veya rakamla başlayın.
dict.idTaken: Bu tanımlayıcıya sahip bir ön ayar zaten var.
dict.deleteDescription: The preset directory is deleted. Oturums already running on it keep working; yeni oturums cannot seç it.
